tools.name: get_crypto_prices
tools.description: Live price, real-market-cap rank, market cap, 24h change, 24h high/low and volume for up to 20 cryptocurrencies. Accepts tickers (BTC), names (Solana) or ids (bitcoin). Use it for "what is X at", "how is X doing" and comparisons between coins.

tools.name: get_top_cryptos
tools.description: RealCryptoCap rankings and prices for the top 50 cryptocurrencies.

tools.name: get_market_brief
tools.description: Public Bitcoin snapshot, Top 50 movers, and news headlines.

tools.name: get_crypto_news
tools.description: Latest crypto market headlines with source, date and link.

tools.name: get_fear_greed
tools.description: Latest public crypto Fear & Greed reading. Pro and Ultra can also access history.

title: Tool description changed since last scan
detail: Tool "get_top_cryptos" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Ranking of native cryptocurrencies by real market cap (stablecoins, wrapped/staked receipts and tokenized assets listed separately), with live price and 24h change. Top 50 by default; Pro members can list up to 500." → after: "RealCryptoCap rankings and prices for the top 50 cryptocurrencies."

remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
